war_declared.text: The council has voted for war on {enemy_faction}. I trust every member will record their vote with the care it deserves.
{my_faction} marches against {enemy_faction} on the council's word. I am sure a few lords will find the vote rather sudden.
War with {enemy_faction} is now formally declared. Some of us saw it coming, and I did say so in council.

peace_made.text: Peace with {faction} has been agreed. The council saw sense in the end, though it took more debate than it ought to have.
{my_faction} and {faction} have signed the accord. I drafted the terms myself, so credit where it is due, friends.
The truce with {faction} is sealed. Do keep the peace this season, as I am keeping careful notes on everyone's conduct.

player_joined_my_faction.text: {player} has sworn to {my_faction}, and I could not be more pleased. A wise choice, and one the council will not forget.
Ser {player}, now that you are sworn to {my_faction}, let us meet and talk over a cup of something fine.
{player} has taken the oath to {my_faction}. Let us see whether that loyalty holds through the next few votes.
Ser {player}, I see you have joined {my_faction}. I shall be watching your votes with interest, as I always do.

player_left_my_faction.text: {player} has left {my_faction} for {faction}. A bold move, though I suspect the council will remember who opened the door.
Ser {player}, I was sorry to see you leave {my_faction} for {faction}. Loyalty is a currency, and some of us keep accounts.
Our loss is {faction}'s gain, it seems. I wish {player} well, and I have already redrawn the seating for the next council.
Ser {player}, I understand the pull of {faction}. Do come and speak with me before you commit to anything irrevocable.

player_granted_fief.text: {player} has been granted {fief}. I argued for it in council, quietly and at length, and I am glad it carried.
Ser {player}, congratulations on {fief}. It is a considerable responsibility, and I am sure you will tell me all about it soon.
So {player} now holds {fief}. Such generosity from the throne is always a matter of timing, is it not?
Ser {player}, {fief} is a fine prize. I hope its grain ledgers are in better order than the council's attendance records.

whisper_alliance_offer.text: Ser {player}, {rival} has been quietly working against us, and {enemy_faction} would welcome a friend in that quarter. Might we talk?
Ser {player}, consider an understanding against {rival} and their friends in {enemy_faction}. I would value your support in council.
Ser {player}, {rival} votes only for their own comfort. Let us arrange matters against {enemy_faction} between us, quietly.

my_faction_took_fief.text: {my_faction} has taken {fief} from {enemy_faction}. I trust the council will record the victory with proper ceremony.
The banners of {my_faction} now fly over {fief}, while {enemy_faction} sulks in its tents. A fine result for the council's strategy.
{fief} is in our hands after {enemy_faction}'s defeat there. I did recommend the campaign, though I shall not labour the point.

player_took_my_fief.text: {player} has taken {fief} from us. Bold of them, though I shall recall every grain they owe before the next council sits.
Ser {player}, you have taken {fief} from our hold. I shall not forget it, and the council will hear every detail of it.
{fief} changed hands to {player} this week. Fortune favours the energetic, and I shall try to be energetic too.
Ser {player}, {fief} is yours now, I see. Do send word on how you intend to govern it, since the council will ask.

encounter_alliance_yes.text: Ser {player}, I accept. {rival} has been a thorn in the council for too long, and {enemy_faction} would be wise to take note of our arrangement.
Agreed, Ser {player}. We shall oppose {rival} together in council and let {enemy_faction} discover the consequences at its leisure.
Ser {player}, a gracious offer, and I accept it gladly. Between us we shall keep {rival} and {enemy_faction} thoroughly outvoted.

encounter_alliance_no.text: Ser {player}, I think not. I have seen how {rival} treats their friends, and I would rather not give them the chance.
Ser {player}, your offer is appreciated, but I must decline. The council has not yet decided where {rival} stands, and I will not commit before then.
Ser {player}, I am flattered, truly. Yet I cannot tie myself to anything while {rival} still sits on the regency bench, so forgive me.

ambient_chatter.text: The roads out of {town} are muddy again, and the council has still not approved the repairs. Shall the carts simply sink, then?
Has anyone heard from {village} about the harvest? I would like a clear account before the next vote, if anyone can spare the time.
The weather over {town} is dreadful, yet the minutes still arrive on time. Some small mercies are worth recording, I think.
I am told {village} has a new reeve, and I intend to write to him at once. Proper introductions matter far more than people admit.
